title: Turning tracking off and on writes two Part History entries
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), a role that has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Create & Edit' and 'Delete'.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-TRKHIST-01) is tracked at {Location-A} with nothing on hand (quantity 0) and is active.
custom_steps:
1. Open {Part-A}, switch "Track quantities and cost of goods" off and click Save.
  2. Open {Part-A} again, switch it on and click Save.
  3. Open {Part-A}'s Part History.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: It saves with no confirmation and Total Qty reads "Not Tracked".
  • Step 2: It saves and Total Qty reads 0.
  • Step 3: Two entries, newest first: "Tracking turned on" and "Tracking turned off" (written even with 0 on hand).

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10823 (Story 10, Confirming and Recording a Status Change); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S10-R22, S5-R5, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 5.5 (Part History), 13 Oct copy. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S10-R22: “Turning tracking off writes the entry "Tracking turned off" to the part's Part History, and turning it on writes "Tracking turned on". A part with nothing on hand still gets the entry.”
  • S5-R5: “Turning tracking off asks for no confirmation, whatever the part holds.”
